title: Hover cards on names, and a clickable overdue count
text: In the Accounts and Contacts lists, rest the mouse on a company name or a person's name and a small card shows their details. A company card shows its type, status, state, client since, main contact, this year's installments and overdue payments. A person card shows email, phone, language, portal stage and their companies. On Accounts, the red "with overdue payments" count is now clickable: it opens the companies with an overdue payment in a floating window. Clicking a name still opens the record.
points: The card opens after a short pause, so moving across the list shows nothing.
Cards never show an EIN, passport, ITIN number or date of birth.
The overdue window follows your filters (status, kind, type, letter, search). Click the red count inside it to show every company again.
Mouse only: a touch screen shows no card.
